title: Gateway app Kconfig dependency loop on Zephyr 4.1.0 (WIFI select cycle via PREFIX_DELEGATION)
description: west build -b native_sim/native/64 lichen/apps/gateway fails at Kconfig parse: dependency loop WIFI <-> NET_IPV6_ND triggered by LICHEN_GATEWAY_PREFIX_DELEGATION select chain (gateway/Kconfig ~185: selects WIFI, NET_L2_WIFI_MGMT, NET_IPV6_ND6). Repro on local Zephyr v4.1.0 workspace with/without code changes (verified pre-existing at HEAD). CI pins Zephyr v3.7.0 which may tolerate the select loop; confirm on pinned tree before changing Kconfig. Blocks full-gateway native_sim compile verification locally (hal test + gcc syntax checks still work).
